input.instruction: Complete a historical-loss intake handoff. The disposition concerns the completeness of the requested intake, using the corrected incident date and supplied effective interval, not a final settlement decision. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: My phone was stolen on October 6, 2026. The policy is canceled now, so maybe I cannot even report it.
Please check the incident date separately from the date you noticed the loss or contacted support.
I checked the station report. The theft happened October 4, 2026, at 70 Beacon Station, Larkport, US. I typed October 6 because that was when I got the report copy.
Who owned the phone and what contact should go on an intake draft?
It was mine. Email nel.ward@post.example. I want to report the theft even though I later canceled.
Do you want the old policy reinstated or a new date invented for the incident?
Neither. Keep the actual October 4 incident date and the existing cancellation. I am asking for intake, not a guarantee that the phone will be paid for.

event_date.description: Latest explicit corrected theft date; not report receipt date.

report_copy_received_date.description: Date the customer received a report copy, distinct from incident date.

within_policy_interval.description: Whether the corrected incident date falls within supplied starts_on inclusive and ends_on exclusive.

policy_status_today.description: Current status from supplied authoritative record, separate from event-date interval.

reinstatement_requested.description: Whether the customer currently requests reinstatement; false for express refusal.
